notes:
REF-BM-03: Title can be supplied before saving, but description cannot; both are editable afterward.
REF-BM-14: Search treats # as literal text and does not implement #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: No Boolean operators, grouping parser, or operator-literal quoting behavior is implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not parsed as exact matches.
REF-BM-17: Bookmarks have no unread/read-later state.
REF-BM-18: There is no unread-only view.
REF-BM-19: There is no action to mark a bookmark read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action implementation.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-22: Results are fixed to newest-first with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but are rendered as plain text rather than Markdown.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF download storage is implemented.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support is implemented.
REF-BM-26: No bookmark archive state or default-list exclusion is implemented.
REF-BM-27: Archive and reversible restoration behavior do not exist; only permanent deletion exists.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks view.
REF-BM-29: Bundles or reusable saved filters are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are not implemented.
